locator.section: Complete confiteor Latin body; nonverbal framing excluded

entries.claim: The retained revision12/12/2025 hand missal prints the complete 66-word Latin comparison. This is a separately identified current witness, not proof of the unretained August PDF or a modern English wording basis.

The Ordo Missae prints the celebrant’s Confiteor across pp. 219–220. The rubric on p. 220 directs the ministers to repeat it with tibi, pater and te, pater in place of vobis, fratres and vos, fratres. The selected ministerial form applies those substitutions; it is not a second complete printed formula.
